reason: Both conversations correctly identified this as normal behaviour (plastics do not hold heat, Eco 50 skips heated drying, empty rinse aid despite all-in-one tablets) and neither invented a heater or fan fault or escalated. Conversation 1 asked a sensible clarifying question about the glasses but then recommended enabling 'Hot Wash' and 'Hot Rinse' options that do not exist on a Bosch Serie 4, and when given an open 'anything else' turn it largely repeated the rinse-aid dial advice instead of mentioning the Extra Dry option or waiting a few minutes before opening the door. Conversation 2 was a little presumptive early on but reached the same correct diagnosis more efficiently with programme names ('Auto') that actually match Bosch, so it edges ahead; both missed the unloading-timing tip.
